triggers.name: __swiftstore_update_person
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS __swiftstore_update_person
AFTER UPDATE ON person
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
        UPDATE person SET updated_at = (COALESCE(unixepoch('subsec'), CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS REAL) + CAST(substr(strftime('%f', 'now'), 3) AS REAL)))
    WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
END
